items.html: And the reason is that ZA, once his Partzuf is completed at nine years and one day, ascends upward in the secret of the NHY of Aba and Ima, and there he immediately encounters the secret of the upper circumcision, the Yesod of Aba, and Mochin are made for him from there, and he is fit to give birth. But the lower infant, although since nine years and one day have passed over him his Partzuf is completed, nevertheless he still needs to ascend upward to receive the Mochin fit for giving birth, and in his ascent he first encounters the place of the upper foreskin, which overshadows the holy circumcision.
